import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
gni_per_capita = gni_per_capita_df.filter(regex='YR').values
exports_growth = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and per capita GDP
correlation_education_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between per capita GDP and economic output (exports growth)
correlation_gni_exports = np.corrcoef(gni_per_capita, exports_growth)[0, 1]

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and economic output
correlation_education_exports = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, exports_growth)[0, 1]

correlation_education_gni, correlation_gni_exports, correlation_education_exports

# Check for missing data in the datasets
missing_data_education = adjusted_savings_df.isnull().sum()
missing_data_gni = gni_per_capita_df.isnull().sum()
missing_data_exports = exports_df.isnull().sum()

missing_data_education, missing_data_gni, missing_data_exports

# Address missing data by dropping rows with missing values
gni_per_capita_clean = gni_per_capita_df.dropna()
exports_clean = exports_df.dropna()

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure_clean = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
gni_per_capita_clean_values = gni_per_capita_clean.filter(regex='YR').values
exports_clean_values = exports_clean.filter(regex='YR').values

# Perform regression analysis between education expenditure and economic output (exports growth)
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X = education_expenditure_clean
y = exports_clean_values

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficient
coefficient_education_exports = model.coef_

# Perform regression analysis between GNI per capita and economic output (exports growth)
X_gni = gni_per_capita_clean_values
y_gni = exports_clean_values

# Create a linear regression model
model_gni = LinearRegression()
model_gni.fit(X_gni, y_gni)

# Get the coefficient
coefficient_gni_exports = model_gni.coef_

coefficient_education_exports, coefficient_gni_exports
